complication: The supplier's statement and our ledger disagree, so the payable balance cannot be closed.
key_question: What explains the gap between the supplier's statement and our ledger, and what should be posted?

work.title: Email to the supplier's accounts team
work.for: The supplier's accounts team, email for the controller to approve before sending
body: Hello, we are reconciling our account with you for month end.
Your statement shows [F1]. We sent a payment of [F4] on the last day of the month that is not on your statement yet; could you confirm it has reached you?
Could you also send a copy of the invoice for [F3] and confirm the credit note for [F5], so we can enter both?
Thank you, the accounts payable team.
